item.title: Pentagon Adopts New Limits for Journalists After Court Loss
AI boom risks widening wealth divide, says BlackRock's Larry Fink
item.description:
📝 Larry Fink says the AI boom risks accelerating a trend where leading companies pull ahead while others struggle to keep pace. Photograph: Kylie Cooper/Reuters“History suggests that transformative technologies create enormous value – and much of that value accrues to the companies that build and deploy them, and to the investors who own them,” Fink said. “It’s hard not to empathise with people dealing with this,” Fink said.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/mar/23/ai-boom-risks-widening-wealth-divide-blackrock-larry-fink
